_DESIGN_RULE: Every number the game plays with lives here and nowhere else, so a retune is a data edit and test_engine.py catches it if a RULE moved instead of a number. appeal_step is load-bearing against interests.json: appeal = appeal_step * (interest_count - rank), so rank 1 opens at 40 and rank 9 at 0. Cards must always move LESS than one appeal_step, or a card becomes a substitute for a good read and diagnosis stops paying.
